notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity JAN 16!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hAjIGSoL9c0;full][/previewyoutube]
Extreme Evolution is my 4th solo-dev game, a culmination of my platforming ideas and theories. Three generations advanced from Space Hole 2016, Extreme Evolution is an extreme interpretation of many of the same influences as Space Hole 2016, and especially 2018!
I'm really excited to release this game on January 16 (2024)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111360/Extreme_Evolution_Drive_to_Divinity/

notes.title: Space Hole 2016 patch 5
notes.content:
* Fixed the achievement trigger
* Removed the reset ceiling from the main menu, now you can bomb jump more freely

notes.title: finally, it is time for- Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity
notes.content:
I've been working in secret on my 4th game for a while, but now it's public! If you enjoy Space Hole (especially 2018) you'll love Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity.

This new game is a lot larger than any I've made before, and will be another collaboration with DL Salo's music! It's about biological transformation.  Follow the steam page below or the join [url=https://discord.gg/MB2kvpX5um]the space hole discord[/url] for all the updates!

[previewyoutube=PsbOYvs7l_g;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111360/Extreme_Evolution_Drive_to_Divinity/

notes.title: Space Hole 2016 Patch 4
notes.content:
Hi all! 
I fixed some stuff in Space Hole 2016! 

* Improved performance on hubs
* Fixed bad text on the ground in Double Earth hub
* Updated the final level to have more stuff in it (Earth is Heavy)
* Tweaked sound effects (reduced volume of impact sounds, added goal sound/more teleport sounds)

Thanks for playing!
-Sam Atlas

notes.title: Space Hole Official Discord!
notes.content:
Hi all!

I've setup a discord community to discuss the Space Hole trilogy, and maybe even upcoming project(s)/ experiment(s)/ game(s)! You can check it out here:

https://discord.gg/MB2kvpX5um

I'd especially love to know the fastest speedrun of Space Hole 2016 :) As always, thank you for playing!

-Sam Atlas

notes.title: Space Hole 2018 Announced!
notes.content:
Space Hole 2016's successor has been unveiled!

Space Hole 2018!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/818410/Space_Hole_2018/

This new Space Hole allows you to fly freely outside of  the ball, and explore non-linear interconnected levels!  I've posted a teaser trailer on the Space Hole 2018 page.

Thank you to all the players of Space Hole 2016! 

-Sam
